covers: Add make local-serve and allow Tailscale dev origins
Turn off Node's own localStorage in the test workers so jsdom's is used on Node 25+

notes.title: Team EvL Online
notes.body: The **Team EvL page** now announces the online game, with a new sticker and a section about it.

notes.title: New Changelog Page
notes.body: You can now see what's new on the site, newest first, on the **changelog page** at infinitelives.io/changelog.

notes.title: Numbered Updates
notes.body: Each update to the site now has its own **version number and date**, so it's easy to tell what changed and when.
